terracotta.name: Terracotta Army
terracotta.hours: Roughly 08:30–17:00, longer in summer; check on the day
terracotta.tip: Go early and see Pit 1 last so the scale hits hardest. Hire a guide or audio guide for context.
terracotta.best: Early morning, avoid weekends and holidays

citywall.name: Xi'an City Wall
citywall.price_text: ≈ CNY 54 entry; bike rental extra (check on the day)
citywall.tip: Rent a bike and ride the full loop — about 14 km, allow 1.5–2 hours. Late afternoon is cooler.

biggoose.name: Big Wild Goose Pagoda
biggoose.price_text: ≈ CNY 50 temple entry; extra to climb the pagoda (check on the day)
biggoose.tip: Come back after dark for the fountain show on the north square — free and lively.
biggoose.best: Late afternoon, then evening fountain show

shaanxi.name: Shaanxi History Museum
shaanxi.price_text: Free with advance booking; some special exhibitions charge
shaanxi.hours: Closed Monday; roughly 09:00–17:30; check on the day
shaanxi.tip: Free tickets are limited and booked online in advance with your passport — reserve days ahead.

muslimquarter.name: Muslim Quarter
muslimquarter.price_text: Free to walk; food paid per stall
muslimquarter.hours: Busiest from late afternoon into the evening
muslimquarter.tip: Eat where locals queue. Try roujiamo, yangrou paomo and cold noodles; carry small cash or use a phone wallet.

belltower.name: Bell Tower of Xi'an
belltower.price_text: ≈ CNY 35; combined ticket with Drum Tower may be cheaper (check on the day)
belltower.tip: Best seen lit up at night from the street or a nearby rooftop. Climb for the view over the old grid.

greatmosque.name: Great Mosque of Xi'an
greatmosque.hours: Roughly 08:00–19:00; closed to tourists at prayer times
greatmosque.tip: A quiet, walled garden complex in Chinese architecture. Dress modestly and keep voices low.
greatmosque.best: Morning, before the quarter gets busy

shuyuanmen.name: Shuyuanmen Culture Street
shuyuanmen.tip: A calm stone-paved lane of calligraphy and brush shops just inside the South Gate — good for gifts.

southgate.name: South Gate (Yongningmen) and moat park
southgate.price_text: Free to view; wall entry charged separately
southgate.hours: Gate area open daily; lit at night
southgate.tip: The grandest gate of the wall. Walk the moat park at dusk, then watch the gate light up.

drumtower.name: Drum Tower of Xi'an
drumtower.price_text: ≈ CNY 35; combined ticket with Bell Tower may be cheaper (check on the day)
drumtower.tip: Short drum performances are held a few times a day — ask at the ticket desk for times.

dacieng.name: Da Ci'en Temple grounds
dacieng.price_text: Free to walk the surrounding squares
dacieng.tip: The north and south squares around the pagoda are free and great for an evening stroll.

fountain.name: North Square fountain show
fountain.hours: Evening shows; times change by season — check on the day
fountain.tip: Arrive 20 minutes early for a front spot. The music-and-water show is a local favourite.

tangshow.name: Tang-dynasty dinner show
tangshow.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–400 depending on seats (check on the day)
tangshow.tip: A song-and-dance show with dinner near the pagoda. Book ahead and confirm what the ticket includes.

bike.name: City Wall bike ride
bike.price_text: ≈ CNY 45 per bike for a set time; deposit may apply (check on the day)
bike.tip: Ride the full loop for the best views of old and new Xi'an. Bring water; shade is limited.

huimin.name: Huimin Street food walk
huimin.price_text: Free to walk; pay per stall
huimin.tip: Skip the main drag and eat on the side lanes. Try grilled skewers, persimmon cakes and paomo.

defu.name: Defu Lane coffee and bar street
defu.price_text: Free to walk; drinks paid separately
defu.hours: Cafes and bars from afternoon into late night
defu.tip: A relaxed lane of small cafes and bars inside the wall — good for a slow afternoon away from crowds.

beilin.name: Beilin Museum (Forest of Stone Steles)
beilin.tip: Carved stone tablets with centuries of calligraphy. Quiet and close to the South Gate.

damingpalace.name: Daming Palace National Heritage Park
damingpalace.price_text: ≈ CNY 60 for the core site; park areas may be free (check on the day)
damingpalace.tip: Vast ruins of a Tang palace. Bring sun protection — there is little shade.

huangcheng.name: Huangcheng Park
huangcheng.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk
huangcheng.tip: A local park on the old wall line — good for people-watching, tai chi and a rest between sights.

northstation.name: Xi'an North Station area
northstation.hours: Station open long hours; check trains on the day
northstation.tip: High-speed trains to the Terracotta Army region and other cities leave from here. Allow extra time for security.

xianfood.name: Xi'an dumpling and noodle dinner
xianfood.price_text: ≈ CNY 60–120 per person (check on the day)
xianfood.tip: Try a dumpling banquet or a bowl of biangbiang noodles near the Bell Tower. Book popular places at weekends.

calligraphy.name: Calligraphy class or brush workshop
calligraphy.price_text: ≈ CNY 100–250 depending on the class (check on the day)
calligraphy.tip: A hands-on hour with brush and ink near Shuyuanmen. Book a day ahead and confirm the language of instruction.

nightwalk.name: Bell Tower night lights walk
nightwalk.tip: Walk from the Bell Tower to the South Gate along the lit-up streets for the classic Xi'an night view.

huashan.name: Terracotta Army day tour with guide
huashan.price_text: ≈ CNY 250–450 including transport and entry (check on the day)
huashan.hours: Half-day tours usually leave in the morning
huashan.tip: A guided half-day trip saves the hassle of finding the site. Confirm entry tickets and pickup are included.
